digest.component_or_area: code review verification and impact scoring (code-v4 redesign)
propositions: Code-v3 impact model discards verifier prod_impact and trigger_likelihood judgments for maintainability findings, causing test-sufficiency findings to score ~0.30 (advisory at 0.95 threshold) despite load-bearing paths

Contract-contradicting assertions (test forbids state the diff contract declares allowed) are not flagged by Pass-1 refactor-based litmus or Pass-3 maint lane, allowing dystopian-bardlike-basil escape where stale>0 contract co-ships with stale=0 assertion

Code-v4 re-scopes prod_impact/trigger_likelihood to capture guarded-path user reach (not diff file type) and applies lane-specific multipliers (serious undamped, moderate prod-impact-keyed, debt churn-amplified-only) to block 99 changes (8.0%) vs v3's 42 (3.4%)
New forbids_contract_allowed_state binary with both-halves-verbatim evidence and tightening guard prevents false positives while capturing the contract-assertion contradiction antipattern

Reversibility floor restricted to consequence lanes (consequence base>0 AND hard_to_reverse_surface); debt never floors, preserving replay invariant (163/99 blocking set, zero demotions, 4 debt+hard_to_reverse stay advisory)
Tests blocking threshold flipped from advisory@0.95 to blocking@0.54 via packaged criteria_routing.json; HIGH/NIT median separation maintained >0.30 under v4 (median HIGH 0.90, NIT 0.24)
